decisions.reason: Adding one spare current-monitor channel does not change DCDC1 voltage, rating, regulation, or load-supply behavior.
Monitoring both rails with one spare channel does not change the 5V boost converter, enable control, output rating, or powered loads.
The spare monitoring channel does not alter the AXP2101 battery input or system power-path behavior.
The source concerns electrical current-monitor channels, not the battery NTC interface or thermal protection.
The number of spare current-monitor channels does not resolve or modify the battery connector family, pins, or pin order.
The source does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, or DW01A protection requirements.
Current-monitor channel availability does not affect the battery-charge LED connector, resistor, or display method.
The source does not change the standalone USB regulator, source selection, activation condition, or supplied 3.3V rail.
Measuring the 5V and 3.3V rails with a spare channel does not change LED supply, level shifting, data control, or standby switching.
The source does not alter interboard connector partitioning, pinout, or distribution of the 5V and 3.3V rails.
Current-monitor channel allocation has no necessary effect on the established four-layer PCB stack.
The spare current-monitor channel does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or its part number.
